author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] Phase 1 (page only) landed: 'Search before <day>' walks up to 5 older pages (15 s budget, stops after 3 new matches) in both layouts, Enter starts it, Stop cancels; Hide read steps aside while filtering; scrolling no longer auto-loads under a filter (it loaded the whole history); Main offers 'Search All — thread replies too'. Server-side search over older history (Phase 2) is planned through #208 persistent-cache M8 (FTS index), so this stays open for that.
